No public entry deletes/changes the source message or expires the project grant; transaction-failure injection is not exposed. These remain NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: context preview now exists, but automatic proposal confirmation and grant/revocation invalidation do not. Required inputs: proposal id/revision, source message and digest, current grant/scope/profile/contract, decision to confirm, plus context preview with project/conversation/work binding, window and invalidity. Planned negatives: unconfirmed means no execution; a failed original command leaves no half-confirmed state; an unknown response reuses the same command id; source/actor/grant/scope/profile/version drift is refused; revoke invalidates later context; cross-project isolation and reopen.

NOT_TESTED: E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW verifies clamped budgets, omissions and basic refusals, but no public entry binds an expired grant or purpose mismatch to the read path. Required: expired grant, purpose mismatch, caller budget above the grant and negative/NaN budget must be refused before any provider read, with the effective window and truncation reported. The C composer probe shows these still fail at the library boundary, so a product pass cannot be claimed.

stages.title: First result: safe complete browser tool
notes: The packaged stop runs first and its real result is read; a refusal becomes a recorded product finding with per-pid equivalent proof, and unknown material is retained.

cases.reason: Distribution source paths absent from this checkout: none. A frozen tar.gz is published outside Git and independently accepted by E4-INSTALL-*; source-level installation and migration remain Agent D owned and are not claimed by this case.

Read-only inspect/prepare are verified (plan authorization=not_granted, commitAvailable=false, no writes, stale/foreign/commit refused). The commit path, expiry/drift/replay/rollback of a real grant, and activation of only new work are not implemented and stay NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: current main product path uses ProductExecution with fixture/Codex profiles, but B's new production control candidate is not consumed by main and native execution is outside this wave. Required: actual product begin command -> Work/Ticket/effect/fact_receipts/dispatch_receipts/answers/answer_deliveries/user_questions/runtime rows, real transport/epoch counts, independent process SIGKILL, unknown no resend, and stop/answer through the existing queue. A fixture or receipt-only row is not production recovery.

stages.title: A/C artifact and derived content evidence

cases.reason: No executed native stop/question/recovery evidence is available in this checkout.

NOT_TESTED: main has published RecoveryTargetConfiguration/preparation/material/inventory schemas and a configuration binder, but no commit/activate HTTP or composed target startup. Required inputs: source-committed activation fact, A read-only inventory, D materializer readback, main activation pointer switch, and crash replay semantics. Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority. A schema or read-only prepare is not activation.

cases.reason: NOT_REACHED: the frozen package has no content-binding consumer in main; the packaged producer verify checks database integrity, schema and artifact digests only, so a legal target-only append stays verified. This is a recorded product gap for the C/A owners, not an acceptance pass.

NOT_REACHED: the scope-review marker exists in this package and its backend ?scopeReview=1 plain/narrow responses are measured, but the independent browser expansion of a restored message scope has not been recorded. Navigation and the trial workbench are separately browser-verified in E3-TRIAL-WORKBENCH-UI.

stages.title: Third result: qualified controlled chain and visible fields

stages.title: Complete required and provenance consistency

stages.title: Docs and long-term not-reached items

notes: wave27-status, five checkpoints, real commands/exit/tuples/consumers/times and remaining gates; the goal continues where layers are NOT_REACHED.
Controlled fixture, SDK mock, readonly and installed evidence never substitute for actual-native execution.
A NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED gap is honest only when the release claim excludes that capability; there is no allow-gap switch.

externalBlockers.detail: NOT_TESTED: current main product path uses ProductExecution with fixture/Codex profiles, but B's new production control candidate is not consumed by main and native execution is outside this wave. Required: actual product begin command -> Work/Ticket/effect/fact_receipts/dispatch_receipts/answers/answer_deliveries/user_questions/runtime rows, real transport/epoch counts, independent process SIGKILL, unknown no resend, and stop/answer through the existing queue. A fixture or receipt-only row is not production recovery.

NOT_TESTED: main has published RecoveryTargetConfiguration/preparation/material/inventory schemas and a configuration binder, but no commit/activate HTTP or composed target startup. Required inputs: source-committed activation fact, A read-only inventory, D materializer readback, main activation pointer switch, and crash replay semantics. Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority. A schema or read-only prepare is not activation.

next: D: bind the single install instance record to its exact data root and make a stop aimed at another state refuse without signalling that state's launcher/API; then E can measure launcher-dead/API-alive and PID/start reuse windows.

C/main: publish automatic proposal/context confirmation, the context-use send path (explicit selection, revalidation, same-transaction binding/receipt, no auto-resend, source audit) and recovery activation; E then converts E5-CONTEXT-USE and E5-RECOVERY-INTERRUPTION from NOT_TESTED.
D: keep the target immutable; a new target needs its own explicit identity (tar/sha/source/build/schema) and a fresh E4 run, not a mapping from build f2390ffd.
B: hand off native evidence bound to commit/attempt/command with executed=true and model-task counts; only a separately granted budget lets E re-run native.
Main: treat controlled-product-workflow PASS as workflow evidence only; local-alpha and full-product remain non-zero until installation and native evidence exist.
